title: Home Oxygen Therapy Paid-Month Span: Where the Stay Fell Within the Last Paid Month
content:
# Where the Stay Fell Within the Last Paid Month — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** A new Home Oxygen Therapy payment period after a break begins on the day home instead of the day of confirmation only when the suspension date falls on or after the first day of the most recent equipment month paid under the coverage named on the oxygen record and no more than the span below after it. The coverage class is the class of the coverage named on the oxygen record, read from the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records. Days are calendar days, counted as the later date less the earlier date. When the condition fails, the new payment period begins on the day the patient confirms continuing.

| Coverage class | Suspension date no more than this many days after the first day of the most recent equipment month paid under the coverage on the oxygen record |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO, Commercial HMO | 31 |
| Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Supplement Plan G, Medicare Advantage PPO, Medicare Advantage HMO | 28 |
| any other coverage class | 21 |

## Both sides (hypothetical, most recent equipment month paid under the coverage on the oxygen record beginning 10 January)

| Coverage class | Suspension date | Days after 10 January | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial HMO | 10 February | 31 | met |
| Commercial HMO | 11 February | 32 | fails |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 7 February | 28 | met |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 8 February | 29 | fails |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 31 January | 21 | met |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 1 February | 22 | fails |
| any class | 9 January | before the month began | fails |
